===== loadData =====
function loadData(){var r=await fetch(DATA,{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'text/plain;charset=UTF-8'},body:JSON.stringify({token:token||''}),cache:'no-store'}),j=await r.json().catch(function(){return {error:'Respuesta no válida'}});if(!r.ok)throw Error(j.error||'Error');return j}
function metricLabel(k){var m={minutes:'Minutos',distance:'Distancia',mmin:'m/min',hsr:'HSR',sprint24:'Sprint >24',maxSpeed:'V. máxima',acc4:'Acc >4',dec4:'Dec >4',playerLoad:'Player Load',avgHr:'FC media',maxHr:'FC máx'};return m[k]||k}
function eventRow(x){var c=x.color||'#5f7f9f';return '<div class="card" style="padding:12px 14px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:center;border-left:6px solid '+esc(c)+'"><div><b style="font-size:12px">'+esc(x.title)+'</b><div class="meta">'+esc(dstr(x.date))+(x.time?' · '+esc(x.time):'')+(x.duration?' · '+esc(x.duration)+' min':'')+'</div></div><span class="pill" style="background:'+esc(c)+';color:#fff">'+(x.kind==='strength'?'Fuerza':x.kind==='field'?'Campo':x.kind==='match'?'Partido':'Evento')+'</span></div>'}
function renderHome(){var r=model.report||{},p=model.player||{};el('hello').textContent='Hola, '+(p.firstName||String(p.name||'jugador').split(' ')[0]);el('homeKpis').innerHTML=kpi('Sesiones campo',r.fieldSessions||0,'registradas')+kpi('Sesiones fuerza',r.strengthSessions||0,'registradas')+kpi('Distancia GPS',nfmt((r.totalDistanceMeters||0)/1000,2)+' km','acumulada')+kpi('Mejor Vmáx',nfmt(r.bestSpeedKmh,2)+' km/h','registrada');var ev=arr(model.calendar).filter(function(x){return x.date>=today}).slice(0,5);el('nextEvents').innerHTML=ev.length?ev.map(eventRow).join(''):empty('No tienes próximos eventos registrados.');var fs=arr(model.fieldSessions).filter(function(x){return x.gps&&Object.keys((x.gps||{}).values||{}).length}).slice(0,3);el('homeGps').innerHTML=fs.length?fs.map(gpsCard).join(''):rawGps(arr(model.gpsRaw).slice(0,3))}
function gpsCard(x){var vals=(x.gps&&x.gps.values)||{},keys=(x.gpsMetricIds||Object.keys(vals)).filter(function(k){return vals[k]!==undefined&&String(vals[k]).trim()!==''}).slice(0,12),ms=keys.map(function(k){return metric(metricLabel(k),vals[k])}).join('');return '<div class="gps-card"><div class="gps-top"><div><h4>'+esc(x.name)+'</h4><div class="meta">'+esc(dstr(x.date))+(x.time?' · '+esc(x.time):'')+'</div></div><span class="pill field">GPS</span></div>'+(ms?'<div class="metrics">'+ms+'</div>':'<div class="meta">Sin métricas GPS cargadas.</div>')+'</div>'}
function rawGps(rows){return rows.length?rows.map(function(r){var date=r.startEpoch?new Date(r.startEpoch*1000).toLocaleDateString('es-ES'):r.date||'';return '<div class="gps-card"><div class="gps-top"><div><h4>'+esc(r.deviceName||'Registro GPS')+'</h4><div class="meta">'+esc(date)+'</div></div><span class="pill field">GPS</span></div><div class="metrics">'+metric('Distancia',nfmt(r.distanceMeters,0)+' m')+metric('V. máxima',nfmt(r.maxSpeed,2)+' km/h')+metric('V. media',nfmt(r.avgSpeed,2)+' km/h')+metric('Duración',nfmt((r.durationSec||0)/60,0)+' min')+'</div></div>'}).join(''):empty('Todavía no hay datos GPS individuales vinculados a tu perfil.')}
function renderGps(){var fs=arr(model.fieldSessions).filter(function(x){return x.gps});el('gpsList').innerHTML=fs.length?fs.map(gpsCard).join(''):rawGps(arr(model.gpsRaw))}
function taskTags(t){var a=[];if(t.duration)a.push(t.duration+' min');if(t.series)a.push(t.series+' series');if(t.reps)a.push(t.reps+' reps');if(t.rest)a.push('Pausa '+t.rest);if(t.family)a.push(t.family);return a.map(function(x){return '<span class="tag">'+esc(x)+'</span>'}).join('')}
function taskText(t){return [t.instructions,t.description,t.objective,t.content,t.notes].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')}
function participantHtml(list,color){list=arr(list);if(!list.length)return '';return '<div class="session-participants"><b>Compañeros que participan · '+list.length+'</b><div class="participant-chips">'+list.map(function(p){return '<span class="participant-chip '+(p.isMe?'me':'')+'">'+esc(p.name||p.firstName||'Jugador')+(p.isMe?' · Tú':'')+'</span>'}).join('')+'</div></div>'}
function renderField(){var rows=arr(model.fieldSessions);el('fieldList').innerHTML=rows.length?rows.map(function(x,i){var blocks=arr(x.blocks).filter(function(b){return arr(b.tasks).length}),body='';if(blocks.length){body=blocks.map(function(b){return '<div class="block"><div class="block-head">'+(b.code?'<span class="block-code">'+esc(b.code)+'</span>':'')+'<span>'+esc(b.name||'Bloque')+'</span></div><div class="task-grid">'+arr(b.tasks).map(function(t){var txt=taskText(t);return '<div class="task-card"><b>'+esc(t.name||'Tarea')+'</b><div class="task-data">'+taskTags(t)+'</div>'+(txt?'<div class="task-text">'+esc(txt)+'</div>':'')+'</div>'}).join('')+'</div></div>'}).join('')}else if(arr(x.tasks).length){body='<div class="task-grid">'+arr(x.tasks).map(function(t){return '<div class="task-card"><b>'+esc(t.name||'Tarea')+'</b><div class="task-data">'+taskTags(t)+'</div><div class="task-text">'+esc(taskText(t))+'</div></div>'}).join('')+'</div>'}else body='<div class="no-tasks">Sin tareas registradas en esta sesión.</div>';return '<details class="session" style="border-left:6px solid '+esc(x.color||'#5f7f9f')+'" '+(i<2?'open':'')+'><summary><div class="session-title"><b>'+esc(x.macroDisplayName||x.name||'Sesión de campo')+'</b><div class="meta">'+esc(dstr(x.date))+(x.time?' · '+esc(x.time):'')+(x.matchDay?' · '+esc(x.matchDay):'')+'</div></div><span class="pill field" style="background:'+esc(x.color||'#2f80ed')+';color:#fff">Campo</span></summary><div class="session-body">'+participantHtml(x.participants,x.color)+body+'</div></details>'}).join(''):empty('No hay sesiones de campo vinculadas a ti.')}
function borg(v){var s=String(v||'');var m=s.match(/(\d+)(?!.*\d)/);return m?m[1]:s||'—'}function dose(e){if(e.doseMode==='seconds'||e.duration)return e.duration?e.duration+' s':(e.reps?e.reps+' s':'—');return e.reps!==''&&e.reps!=null?e.reps:'—'}
function renderStrength(){var rows=arr(model.strengthSessions);el('strengthList').innerHTML=rows.length?rows.map(function(x,i){var load=x.load||{},exCount=arr(x.blocks).reduce(function(a,b){return a+arr(b.exercises).length},0),sum='<div class="metrics strength-summary">'+metric('Ejercicios',load.exercises!=null?load.exercises:exCount)+metric('Series',load.sets!=null?nfmt(load.sets,0):'—')+metric('Reps',load.reps!=null?nfmt(load.reps,0):'—')+metric('Carga UA',load.ua!=null?nfmt(load.ua,1):'—')+'</div>';var trs='';arr(x.blocks).forEach(function(b){if(!arr(b.exercises).length)return;trs+='<tr class="strength-block-row"><td colspan="7">'+esc((b.code?b.code+' · ':'')+(b.name||'Bloque'))+'</td></tr>';arr(b.exercises).forEach(function(e){trs+='<tr><td>'+esc(e.name||'Ejercicio')+(e.description?'<div class="meta">'+esc(e.description)+'</div>':'')+'</td><td>'+esc(e.sets||'—')+'</td><td>'+esc(dose(e))+'</td><td>'+esc(e.load||'—')+'</td><td>'+esc(borg(e.rpe))+'</td><td>'+esc(e.laterality||e.side||'—')+'</td><td>'+esc(e.rest||'—')+'</td></tr>'})});var table=trs?'<div class="table-wrap"><table class="strength-table"><thead><tr><th>Ejercicio</th><th>Series</th><th>Reps / tiempo</th><th>Carga</th><th>Borg</th><th>Lateralidad</th><th>Descanso</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+trs+'</tbody></table></div>':'<div class="no-tasks">Sin ejercicios registrados en esta sesión.</div>';return '<details class="session" style="border-left:6px solid '+esc(x.color||'#5f7f9f')+'" '+(i<2?'open':'')+'><summary><div class="session-title"><b>'+esc(x.macroDisplayName||x.name||'Sesión de fuerza')+'</b><div class="meta">'+esc(dstr(x.date))+(x.time?' · '+esc(x.time):'')+(x.duration?' · '+esc(x.duration)+' min':'')+'</div></div><span class="pill strength" style="background:'+esc(x.color||'#7055b8')+';color:#fff">Fuerza</span></summary><div class="session-body">'+participantHtml(x.participants,x.color)+sum+table+'</div></details>'}).join(''):empty('No hay sesiones de fuerza vinculadas a ti.')}
function dateKey(d){return d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}function monday(d){var x=new Date(d.getFullYear(),d.getMonth(),d.getDate()),day=(x.getDay()+6)%7;x.setDate(x.getDate()-day);return x}function addDays(d,n){var x=new Date(d);x.setDate(x.getDate()+n);return x}function eventsOn(key){return arr(model.calendar).filter(function(x){return x.date===key})}function eventChip(x){var c=x.color||'#5f7f9f';return '<button class="event-chip '+esc(x.kind||'event')+'" style="--ec:'+esc(c)+';background:'+esc(c)+'22;color:'+esc(c)+'" data-event-id="'+esc(x.id)+'" title="'+esc((x.time?x.time+' · ':'')+x.title)+'">'+esc((x.time?x.time+' ':'')+x.title)+'</button>'}
function renderCalendar(){var title,days=[],dows=['Lun','Mar','Mié','Jue','Vie','Sáb','Dom'];if(calendarMode==='month'){var y=calendarCursor.getFullYear(),m=calendarCursor.getMonth(),first=new Date(y,m,1),start=monday(first);title=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('es-ES',{month:'long',year:'numeric'}).format(first);for(var i=0;i<42;i++)days.push(addDays(start,i))}else{var start=monday(calendarCursor);title=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('es-ES',{day:'2-digit',month:'short'}).format(start)+' — '+new Intl.DateTimeFormat('es-ES',{day:'2-digit',month:'short',year:'numeric'}).format(addDays(start,6));for(var j=0;j<7;j++)days.push(addDays(start,j))}var head='<div class="cal-toolbar"><div class="cal-title">'+esc(title)+'</div><div class="cal-controls"><button class="cal-btn" data-cal="prev">‹</button><button class="cal-btn" data-cal="today">Hoy</button><button class="cal-btn" data-cal="next">›</button></div><div class="cal-modes"><button class="cal-btn '+(calendarMode==='month'?'active':'')+'" data-mode="month">Mes</button><button class="cal-btn '+(calendarMode==='week'?'active':'')+'" data-mode="week">Semana</button></div></div>';var grid='<div class="cal-grid '+(calendarMode==='week'?'week-grid':'')+'">';if(calendarMode==='month')dows.forEach(function(x){grid+='<div class="cal-dow">'+x+'</div>'});days.forEach(function(d,idx){var key=dateKey(d),ev=eventsOn(key),outm=calendarMode==='month'&&d.getMonth()!==calendarCursor.getMonth(),isToday=key===today,lab=calendarMode==='week'?'<div class="week-head">'+dows[idx]+' · '+d.getDate()+'</div>':'<div class="day-num">'+d.getDate()+'</div>';grid+='<div class="cal-day '+(outm?'out ':'')+(isToday?'today':'')+'">'+lab+ev.map(eventChip).join('')+'</div>'});grid+='</div><div id="calDetail"></div>';el('calendar').innerHTML='<div class="cal-card">'+head+grid+'</div>'}
function showCalEvent(id){var x=arr(model.calendar).find(function(e){return String(e.id)===String(id)});if(!x)return;var c=x.color||'#5f7f9f';el('calDetail').innerHTML='<div class="cal-detail" style="border-left:6px solid '+esc(c)+'"><b>'+esc(x.title)+'</b><div style="margin-top:4px">'+esc(dstr(x.date))+(x.time?' · '+esc(x.time):'')+(x.duration?' · '+esc(x.duration)+' min':'')+'</div>'+(x.comment?'<div style="margin-top:6px">'+esc(x.comment)+'</div>':'')+participantHtml(x.participants,c)+'</div>'}
var V713_FRONT="data:image/jpeg;base64,";
var V713_BACK="data:image/jpeg;base64,";
var v713Labels={
 sleep6:['Muy mal','Mal','Regular','Bien','Muy bien','Excelente'],
 stress6:['Muy estresado','Estresado','Algo estresado','Tranquilo','Muy tranquilo','Nada estresado'],
 fatigue6:['Muy fatigado','Fatigado','Algo fatigado','Bien','Fresco','Muy fresco'],
 soreness6:['Mucho dolor','Dolor','Algo de dolor','Poco dolor','Muy poco','Nada']
};
function v713FaceGrid(key,val){var a=v713Labels[key]||[];var h='<div class="v713-face-grid">';for(var i=1;i<=6;i++)h+='<button type="button" class="v713-face '+(Number(val)===i?'sel':'')+'" data-v713-score="'+key+'" data-v="'+i+'"><div class="v713-smiley v713-c'+i+'"><i class="v713-mouth"></i></div><b>'+esc(a[i-1]||i)+'</b><span>'+i+'/6</span></button>';return h+'</div>'}
function v713EntryValue(entry,key){if(!entry)return 0;if(entry[key]!=null)return Number(entry[key])||0;var map={sleep6:'sleep10',stress6:'stress10',fatigue6:'fatigue10',soreness6:'soreness10'},n=Number(entry[map[key]])||0;if(!n)return 0;return Math.max(1,Math.min(6,Math.round(1+(n-1)*5/9)))}
function v713PointTitle(p,i){return (p.view==='back'?'Posterior':'Anterior')+' · punto '+(i+1)}
function renderV713PainPanel(){var panel=el('v713PainPanel');if(!panel)return;var list=ciPains||[];panel.innerHTML='<div class="v713-panelhead"><div><b>Puntos seleccionados</b><div class="sub" style="font-size:9px">Marca el avatar y edita aquí.</div></div><span class="v713-count">'+list.length+'</span></div>'+(list.length?'<div class="v713-pain-list">'+list.map(function(p,i){var sev='';for(var n=1;n<=10;n++)sev+='<button type="button" data-v713-sev="'+i+'" data-v="'+n+'" class="'+(Number(p.severity)===n?'sel':'')+'">'+n+'</button>';return '<div class="v713-pain-card '+(ciPainActive===i?'active':'')+'"><div class="v713-pain-top"><div><div class="v713-pain-title">'+esc(v713PointTitle(p,i))+'</div><div class="v713-pain-meta">Dolor '+esc(p.severity||5)+'/10</div></div><button type="button" data-v713-remove="'+i+'">×</button></div><div class="v713-pain-sev">'+sev+'</div><textarea class="textarea" data-v713-comment="'+i+'" placeholder="Comentario opcional">'+esc(p.comment||'')+'</textarea></div>'}).join('')+'</div>':'<div class="v713-pain-empty">Pulsa directamente sobre el avatar. El punto se añade al instante con dolor 5/10.</div>');renderV713Dots()}
function renderV713Dots(){['front','back'].forEach(function(view){var box=el('v713Map_'+view);if(!box)return;box.querySelectorAll('.v713-dot').forEach(function(x){x.remove()});(ciPains||[]).forEach(function(p,i){if((p.view||'front')!==view)return;var d=document.createElement('i');d.className='v713-dot '+(ciPainActive===i?'active':'');d.style.left=(Number(p.x)||50)+'%';d.style.top=(Number(p.y)||50)+'%';box.appendChild(d)})})}
function addV713Point(view,x,y){ciPains.push({id:'pain_'+Date.now()+'_'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6),zone:'point_'+view+'_'+Date.now(),view:view,x:Math.round(x*100)/100,y:Math.round(y*100)/100,severity:5,comment:'',point:true});ciPainActive=ciPains.length-1;renderV713PainPanel()}
function v713Question(n,key,title,sub){var val=Number(el(key)&&el(key).value)||0;return '<div class="v713-section"><div class="v713-rowhead"><span class="v713-num">'+n+'</span><div><h4>'+title+'</h4><p>'+sub+'</p></div></div>'+v713FaceGrid(key,val)+'</div>'}

function renderCheckin(edit){var entry=me&&me.checkIn;if(entry&&!edit){var keys=[['sleep6','Sueño'],['stress6','Estrés'],['fatigue6','Fatiga'],['soreness6','Dolor muscular']];el('checkinRoot').innerHTML='<div class="v713-check v713-saved"><div class="saved-tick">✓</div><h3 style="margin:0">Check In completado</h3><p class="sub">Tu estado de hoy ya está registrado.</p><div class="v713-saved-grid">'+keys.map(function(k){var v=v713EntryValue(entry,k[0]);return '<div><small>'+k[1]+'</small><b>'+(v||'—')+'/6</b></div>'}).join('')+'</div><button class="btn ghost" id="editCi">Editar Check In de hoy</button></div>';el('editCi').onclick=function(){renderCheckin(true)};return}
var p=model&&model.player||me&&me.user||{},first=(p.firstName||p.name||p.displayName||'J').charAt(0).toUpperCase();var vals={};ciMetrics.forEach(function(m){vals[m[0]]=v713EntryValue(entry,m[0])});
var html='<div class="v713-check"><div class="v713-head"><div class="v713-head-main"><div class="v713-head-avatar">'+esc(first)+'</div><div><small>Check-In · '+esc(dstr(today))+'</small><h3>'+esc(p.name||p.displayName||'Jugador')+'</h3><p>'+esc(p.team||'')+(p.position?' · '+esc(p.position):'')+'</p></div></div></div><div class="v713-datebar"><div><small>Fecha del registro</small><b>'+esc(dstr(today))+'</b></div><div><small>Fecha</small><b>'+esc(dstr(today))+'</b></div></div>';
html+='<div class="v713-section"><div class="v713-weight"><div class="v713-kg">kg</div><div class="v713-weight-box"><h4 style="margin:0 0 3px">Añade tu peso</h4><p class="sub" style="margin:0 0 9px">Es opcional; puedes dejarlo sin contestar.</p><div class="v713-weight-line"><input id="ciWeight" class="input" type="number" min="20" max="250" step="0.1" placeholder="Ej. 74.5" value="'+esc(entry&&entry.weight!=null?entry.weight:'')+'"><span>kg</span></div></div></div></div>';
ciMetrics.forEach(function(m){html+='<input id="'+m[0]+'" type="hidden" value="'+(vals[m[0]]||'')+'">'});
html+='<div class="v713-section"><div class="v713-rowhead"><span class="v713-num">1</span><div><h4>¿Cómo ha sido tu sueño?</h4><p>Selecciona una respuesta</p></div></div>'+v713FaceGrid('sleep6',vals.sleep6)+'</div>';
html+='<div class="v713-section"><div class="v713-rowhead"><span class="v713-num">2</span><div><h4>¿Cómo de estresado estás?</h4><p>Selecciona una respuesta</p></div></div>'+v713FaceGrid('stress6',vals.stress6)+'</div>';
html+='<div class="v713-section"><div class="v713-rowhead"><span class="v713-num">3</span><div><h4>¿Cómo es tu nivel de fatiga?</h4><p>Selecciona una respuesta</p></div></div>'+v713FaceGrid('fatigue6',vals.fatigue6)+'</div>';
html+='<div class="v713-section"><div class="v713-rowhead"><span class="v713-num">4</span><div><h4>¿Cuánto es tu dolor muscular?</h4><p>Selecciona una respuesta</p></div></div>'+v713FaceGrid('soreness6',vals.soreness6)+'</div>';
html+='<div class="v713-section v713-comment"><div class="v713-rowhead"><span class="v713-num">5</span><div><h4>Algo que quieras comentar</h4></div></div><textarea id="ciComment" class="textarea" placeholder="Escríbelo aquí...">'+esc(entry&&entry.comment||'')+'</textarea></div>';
html+='<div class="v713-section"><div class="v713-rowhead"><span class="v713-num">6</span><div><h4>Selecciona las zonas que tienes molestias</h4><p>Pulsa una zona, elige una nota del 1 al 10 y añade un comentario si lo necesitas.</p></div></div><div class="v713-body-layout"><div class="v713-avatars"><div class="v713-avatar-card"><b>Vista anterior</b><div id="v713Map_front" class="v713-map" data-v713-map="front"><img draggable="false" src="'+V713_FRONT+'"></div><span class="v713-map-pill">PULSA EN EL PUNTO EXACTO</span><div class="v713-map-note">Pulsa en el punto exacto del avatar. Se añadirá con dolor 5/10.</div></div><div class="v713-avatar-card"><b>Vista posterior</b><div id="v713Map_back" class="v713-map" data-v713-map="back"><img draggable="false" src="'+V713_BACK+'"></div><span class="v713-map-pill">PULSA EN EL PUNTO EXACTO</span><div class="v713-map-note">Pulsa en el punto exacto del avatar. Se añadirá con dolor 5/10.</div></div></div><div id="v713PainPanel" class="v713-painpanel"></div></div></div><div id="ciMsg"></div><div class="v713-actions"><button class="btn primary" id="saveCi">Guardar Check In</button></div></div>';
el('checkinRoot').innerHTML=html;ciPains=entry&&Array.isArray(entry.pains)?entry.pains.map(function(p){return {id:p.id||('pain_'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)),zone:p.zone||('point_'+(p.view||'front')+'_'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)),view:p.view||'front',x:p.x,y:p.y,severity:p.severity||5,comment:p.comment||'',point:true}}):[];ciPainActive=ciPains.length?0:-1;renderV713PainPanel();el('saveCi').onclick=saveCheckin}
async function saveCheckin(){var missing=ciMetrics.filter(function(m){return !Number(el(m[0]).value)});if(missing.length){el('ciMsg').innerHTML='<div class="error" style="margin:14px 24px">Completa las 4 preguntas antes de guardar.</div>';return}var payload={pains:ciPains,comment:el('ciComment').value,weight:el('ciWeight').value};ciMetrics.forEach(function(m){payload[m[0]]=Number(el(m[0]).value)});loading(true);try{var j=await callApi('submit_checkin',payload);me.checkIn=j.entry;try{model=await withTimeout(loadData(),2500,'')}catch(_){}renderCheckin(false);renderHome()}catch(e){el('ciMsg').innerHTML='<div class="error" style="margin:14px 24px">'+esc(e.message)+'</div>'}finally{loading(false)}}
function rpeLabel(v){v=Number(v)||0;if(!v)return 'Selecciona un valor';if(v<=2)return 'Muy suave';if(v<=4)return 'Suave';if(v<=6)return 'Moderado';if(v<=8)return 'Duro';if(v===9)return 'Muy duro';return 'Máximo'}
function co714Labels(){return ['Muy muy ligero','Muy ligero','Ligero','Algo pesado','Pesado','Más pesado','Muy pesado','Muy muy pesado','Máximo','Extremo']}
function scoreButtons(kind,val){var labs=co714Labels(),h='<div class="co714-scale">';for(var i=1;i<=10;i++)h+='<button type="button" data-score="'+kind+'" data-v="'+i+'" class="co714-score co714-c'+i+' '+(Number(val)===i?'sel':'')+'"><strong>'+i+'</strong><small>'+esc(labs[i-1])+'</small></button>';return h+'</div>'}
function co714PainTitle(p,i){return (p.view==='back'?'Punto posterior ':'Punto anterior ')+(i+1)}
function renderCo714Dots(){['front','back'].forEach(function(view){var box=el('co714Map_'+view);if(!box)return;box.querySelectorAll('.co714-dot').forEach(function(x){x.remove()});coPains.forEach(function(p,i){if((p.view||'front')!==view)return;var d=document.createElement('i');d.className='co714-dot '+(coPainActive===i?'active':'');d.style.left=(Number(p.x)||50)+'%';d.style.top=(Number(p.y)||50)+'%';box.appendChild(d)})})}
function renderCo714PainPanel(){var panel=el('co714PainPanel');if(!panel)return;var list=coPains||[];panel.innerHTML='<div class="co714-panelhead"><div><b>Puntos seleccionados</b><div class="sub" style="font-size:9px">Marca el avatar y edita aquí.</div></div><span class="co714-count">'+list.length+'</span></div>'+(list.length?'<div class="co714-pain-list">'+list.map(function(p,i){var sev='';for(var n=1;n<=10;n++)sev+='<button type="button" data-co714-sev="'+i+'" data-v="'+n+'" class="'+(Number(p.severity)===n?'sel':'')+'">'+n+'</button>';return '<div class="co714-pain-card '+(coPainActive===i?'active':'')+'"><div class="co714-pain-top"><div><div class="co714-pain-title">'+esc(co714PainTitle(p,i))+'</div><div class="co714-pain-meta">'+(p.view==='back'?'Vista posterior':'Vista anterior')+' · dolor '+esc(p.severity||5)+'/10</div></div><button type="button" data-co714-remove="'+i+'">×</button></div><div class="co714-sev">'+sev+'</div><textarea class="textarea" data-co714-comment="'+i+'" placeholder="Comentario opcional">'+esc(p.comment||'')+'</textarea></div>'}).join('')+'</div>':'<div class="co714-empty">Pulsa directamente sobre el avatar. El punto se añade al instante con dolor 5/10.</div>');renderCo714Dots()}
function addCo714Point(view,x,y){coPains.push({id:'pain_'+Date.now()+'_'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6),zone:'point_'+view+'_'+Date.now(),view:view,x:Math.round(x*100)/100,y:Math.round(y*100)/100,severity:5,comment:'',point:true});coPainActive=coPains.length-1;renderCo714PainPanel()}

var html='<div class="co714"><div class="v713-head"><div class="v713-head-main"><div class="v713-head-avatar">'+esc(first)+'</div><div><small>Check-Out · '+esc(dstr(today))+'</small><h3>'+esc(p.name||p.displayName||'Jugador')+'</h3><p>'+esc(p.team||'')+(p.position?' · '+esc(p.position):'')+'</p></div></div></div><div class="v713-datebar"><div><small>Fecha del registro</small><b>'+esc(dstr(today))+'</b></div><div><small>Fecha</small><b>'+esc(dstr(today))+'</b></div></div>';
html+='<div class="v713-section"><div class="v713-rowhead"><span class="v713-num">1</span><div><h4>¿Cómo de duro ha sido el entrenamiento de hoy en campo?</h4><p>Selecciona una puntuación del 1 al 10.</p></div></div>'+scoreButtons('field',fieldRpe)+'</div>';
html+='<div class="v713-section"><div class="v713-rowhead"><span class="v713-num">2</span><div><h4>¿Cómo de duro ha sido el entrenamiento de hoy en gimnasio?</h4><p>Selecciona una puntuación del 1 al 10.</p></div></div>'+scoreButtons('gym',gymRpe)+'</div>';
html+='<div class="v713-section co714-comment"><div class="v713-rowhead"><span class="v713-num">3</span><div><h4>¿Quieres comentar alguna cosa?</h4></div></div><textarea id="coComment" class="textarea" placeholder="Escríbela aquí...">'+esc(entry&&entry.comment||'')+'</textarea></div>';
html+='<div class="v713-section"><div class="v713-rowhead"><span class="v713-num">4</span><div><h4>Selecciona las zonas que tienes más sensibles</h4><p>Es opcional. el('checkoutRoot').innerHTML=html;renderCo714PainPanel();el('saveCo').onclick=saveCheckout}
async function saveCheckout(){if(!fieldRpe||!gymRpe){el('coMsg').innerHTML='<div class="error" style="margin:14px 24px">Selecciona un valor del 1 al 10 para campo y gimnasio.</div>';return}loading(true);try{var j=await callApi('submit_checkout',{fieldRpe:fieldRpe,gymRpe:gymRpe,comment:el('coComment').value,pains:coPains});me.checkOut=j.entry;try{model=await withTimeout(loadData(),2500,'')}catch(_){}renderCheckout(false);renderHome()}catch(e){el('coMsg').innerHTML='<div class="error" style="margin:14px 24px">'+esc(e.message)+'</div>'}finally{loading(false)}}
function reportText(v){return String(v==null?'':v).trim()}function renderReport(){var p=model.player||{},ap=model.appPlayerReport||{},c=ap.config||{},has=!!ap.config,sections=[['beforePrat','Antes de class="report-head"><h3>'+esc(p.name||'Jugador')+'</h3><p>'+esc(p.team||'')+(p.position?' · '+esc(p.position):'')+(p.number?' · #'+esc(p.number):'')+'</p></div>';if(!has)html+='<div class="empty">Todavía no hay contenido guardado para este jugador dentro del módulo <b>Informe jugador</b> de ARLAB.</div>';html+='<div class="report-sections">'+sections.map(function(z){var txt=reportText(c[z[0]]);return '<div class="report-section"><h4>'+esc(z[1])+'</h4><p>'+(txt?esc(txt):'<span style="color:#94a5b5">Sin información registrada.</span>')+'</p></div>'}).join('')+'</div>';var mods=[],order=arr(c.moduleOrder),custom=arr(c.customModules),notes=c.moduleNotes||{};order.forEach(function(id){var cm=custom.find(function(x){return String(x.id)===String(id)}),name=cm&&cm.name||id,txt=notes[id]||cm&&cm.notes||'';mods.push({name:name,text:txt})});custom.forEach(function(cm){if(!mods.some(function(x){return x.name===cm.name}))mods.push({name:cm.name||'Módulo',text:notes[cm.id]||cm.notes||''})});if(mods.length)html+='<div class="section"><div class="section-title">Módulos del informe</div><div '+esc(x.comment||x.text||x.note||'')+'</div>'}).join('')+'</div>';html+='</div>';el('report').innerHTML=html}
function renderAll(){var p=model.player||{};el('userName').textContent=p.name||'Jugador';el('userTeam').textContent=p.team||'';el('avatar').textContent=(p.firstName||p.name||'A').charAt(0).toUpperCase();renderHome();renderGps();renderField();renderStrength();renderCalendar();renderCheckin(false);renderCheckout(false);renderReport()}

function renderAll(){var p=model.player||{};el('userName').textContent=p.name||'Jugador';el('userTeam').textContent=p.team||'';el('avatar').textContent=(p.firstName||p.name||'A').charAt(0).toUpperCase();renderHome();renderGps();renderField();renderStrength();renderCalendar();renderCheckin(false);renderCheckout(false);renderReport()}
function localToday(){try{return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA').format(new Date())}catch(_){return new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}}
function minimalModel(user){var name=user&&user.displayName||'Jugador',parts=String(name).trim().split(/\s+/);return {player:{id:user&&user.playerId||'',name:name,firstName:parts[0]||'Jugador',team:user&&user.team||''},fieldSessions:[],strengthSessions:[],gps:[],calendar:[],report:{},tests:[]}}
function showPortalShell(user){today=today||localToday();calendarCursor=new Date(today+'T12:00:00');me=me||{today:today,checkIn:null,checkOut:null,user:user||{}};model=model||minimalModel(user||{});el('login').classList.add('hidden');el('app').classList.remove('hidden');renderAll()}
async function withTimeout(p,ms,msg){var t;try{return await Promise.race([p,new Promise(function(_,rej){t=setTimeout(function(){rej(new Error(msg||'La carga está tardando demasiado'))},ms)})])}finally{clearTimeout(t)}}
async function refreshPortalData(){try{var m=await withTimeout(callApi('me'),6000,'El perfil está tardando demasiado');me=m;today=m.today||today||localToday();calendarCursor=new Date(today+'T12:00:00');renderCheckin(false);renderCheckout(false)}catch(e){console.warn('ARLAB me',e)}try{var d=await withTimeout(loadData(),12000,'Los datos están tardando demasiado');model=d;renderAll()}catch(e){console.warn('ARLAB data',e);var home=el('nextEvents');if(home&&!arr(model&&model.calendar).length)home.innerHTML='<div class="empty">Has entrado correctamente. Los datos del staff están cargando más lento de lo normal; puedes seguir usando el portal y se actualizarán al recargar.</div>'}}
async function enter(){loading(true);try{var m=await withTimeout(callApi('me'),6000,'No se pudo validar la sesión a tiempo');me=m;today=m.today||localToday();var u=m.user||{};showPortalShell(u);loading(false);refreshPortalData()}catch(e){token='';localStorage.removeItem('arlab_player_token');el('app').classList.add('hidden');el('login').classList.remove('hidden');el('loginErr').innerHTML='<div class="error">'+esc(e.message||'No se pudo cargar el portal')+'</div>';loading(false)}}
el('loginBtn').onclick=async function(){var u=el('loginUser').value.trim(),p=el('loginPass').value;el('loginErr').innerHTML='';loading(true);try{var r=await withTimeout(fetch(API,{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'text/plain;charset=UTF-8'},body:JSON.stringify({action:'login',username:u,password:p}),cache:'no-store'}),7000,'El acceso está tardando demasiado'),j=await r.json();if(!r.ok)throw Error(j.error||'No se pudo entrar');token=j.token;localStorage.setItem('arlab_player_token',token);me={today:localToday(),checkIn:null,checkOut:null,user:j.user||{}};model=minimalModel(j.user||{});showPortalShell(j.user||{});loading(false);refreshPortalData()}catch(e){el('loginErr').innerHTML='<div class="error">'+esc(e.message)+'</div>';loading(false)}};el('loginPass').addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Enter')el('loginBtn').click()});el('logout').onclick=async function(){try{await callApi('logout')}catch(_){}localStorage.removeItem('arlab_player_token');location.reload()};
el('nav').addEventListener('click',function(e){var b=e.target.closest('button[data-page]');if(!b)return;document.querySelectorAll('.nav button').forEach(function(x){x.classList.toggle('active',x===b)});document.querySelectorAll('.page').forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove('active')});el('page-'+b.dataset.page).classList.add('active');window.scrollTo(0,0)});
document.addEventListener('click',function(e){var cm=e.target.closest('[data-co714-map]');if(cm){var rr=cm.getBoundingClientRect(),cx=(e.clientX-rr.left)/rr.width*100,cy=(e.clientY-rr.top)/rr.height*100;addCo714Point(cm.getAttribute('data-co714-map'),Math.max(0,Math.min(100,cx)),Math.max(0,Math.min(100,cy)));return}var cs7=e.target.closest('[data-co714-sev]');if(cs7){var ci7=Number(cs7.getAttribute('data-co714-sev'));if(coPains[ci7]){coPains[ci7].severity=Number(cs7.getAttribute('data-v'))||5;coPainActive=ci7;renderCo714PainPanel()}return}var cr7=e.target.closest('[data-co714-remove]');if(cr7){var ri7=Number(cr7.getAttribute('data-co714-remove'));coPains.splice(ri7,1);coPainActive=coPains.length?Math.min(ri7,coPains.length-1):-1;renderCo714PainPanel();return}var vf=e.target.closest('[data-v713-score]');if(vf){var key=vf.getAttribute('data-v713-score'),v=Number(vf.getAttribute('data-v')),inp=el(key);if(inp)inp.value=v;vf.parentNode.querySelectorAll('[data-v713-score]').forEach(function(x){x.classList.toggle('sel',x===vf)});return}var vm=e.target.closest('[data-v713-map]');if(vm){var r=vm.getBoundingClientRect(),x=(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width*100,y=(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height*100;add

===== renderCalendar =====
function renderCalendar(){var title,days=[],dows=['Lun','Mar','Mié','Jue','Vie','Sáb','Dom'];if(calendarMode==='month'){var y=calendarCursor.getFullYear(),m=calendarCursor.getMonth(),first=new Date(y,m,1),start=monday(first);title=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('es-ES',{month:'long',year:'numeric'}).format(first);for(var i=0;i<42;i++)days.push(addDays(start,i))}else{var start=monday(calendarCursor);title=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('es-ES',{day:'2-digit',month:'short'}).format(start)+' — '+new Intl.DateTimeFormat('es-ES',{day:'2-digit',month:'short',year:'numeric'}).format(addDays(start,6));for(var j=0;j<7;j++)days.push(addDays(start,j))}var head='<div class="cal-toolbar"><div class="cal-title">'+esc(title)+'</div><div class="cal-controls"><button class="cal-btn" data-cal="prev">‹</button><button class="cal-btn" data-cal="today">Hoy</button><button class="cal-btn" data-cal="next">›</button></div><div class="cal-modes"><button class="cal-btn '+(calendarMode==='month'?'active':'')+'" data-mode="month">Mes</button><button class="cal-btn '+(calendarMode==='week'?'active':'')+'" data-mode="week">Semana</button></div></div>';var grid='<div class="cal-grid '+(calendarMode==='week'?'week-grid':'')+'">';if(calendarMode==='month')dows.forEach(function(x){grid+='<div class="cal-dow">'+x+'</div>'});days.forEach(function(d,idx){var key=dateKey(d),ev=eventsOn(key),outm=calendarMode==='month'&&d.getMonth()!==calendarCursor.getMonth(),isToday=key===today,lab=calendarMode==='week'?'<div class="week-head">'+dows[idx]+' · '+d.getDate()+'</div>':'<div class="day-num">'+d.getDate()+'</div>';grid+='<div class="cal-day '+(outm?'out ':'')+(isToday?'today':'')+'">'+lab+ev.map(eventChip).join('')+'</div>'});grid+='</div><div id="calDetail"></div>';el('calendar').innerHTML='<div class="cal-card">'+head+grid+'</div>'}
